open_points.subject: Import confirmation after re-uploading identical bytes
open_points.text: A16 says that another upload replaces the file even when it has the same bytes, and requires the earlier confirmation to be refused; but A13 binds the confirmation to the file only by its digest and the picks, while M11 carries no upload incarnation or generation.
open_points.question: How can Registry distinguish the newly uploaded copy from the copy for which the still-pending confirmation was made when their bytes, digest, picks and mapping inputs are identical?
options: Uploading any file clears the pending confirmation.
The session stores an upload incarnation and the confirmation is bound to it.
Identical bytes satisfy the existing digest binding, so the old confirmation remains usable.
open_points.default_guess: Store an upload incarnation and bind the confirmation to it.

witness.initial: One valid owner session holds import file F and a pending confirmation value bound to digest(F), picks P and the mapping inputs.
events: The owner uploads F again in the same session with exactly the same bytes.
The owner submits the original confirmation value with the same picks and inputs.
outcomes: Registry refuses because the second upload replaced the particular file for which the confirmation was shown, as A16 requires.
Registry accepts because the retained file has the bound digest and every value represented in A13 and M11 still matches.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a refused import or a committed import and migration closure.

open_points.subject: Status of the security review after the accepted decisions changed
open_points.text: A21 rule 2 says, "A change to a decision a category names reopens this review," while its current text still says the review is complete and "Security review: PERFORMED" even though A13, A16 and A04—decisions named by its categories—have changed.
open_points.question: After these changes, is A21 reopened pending a new review, or has a new review of the changed rules already been performed and accepted?
options: The review is reopened and is not currently complete.
The displayed review was re-performed against the changed texts and remains complete.
Only some affected categories are reopened while the others remain closed.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the review as reopened until the affected categories are explicitly reviewed again.

witness.initial: A21 is accepted with every category reviewed and marked complete.
events: A16 changes import confirmation eligibility and identical-file replacement.
A04 changes revision checks for records without revisions.
outcomes: A21 rule 2 makes the security review reopened, so later work cannot rely on its completeness claim.
The unchanged status declaration leaves later work treating the security review as performed and complete.
witness.observer: Later design and implementation agents deciding whether the security review is a closed State 2 guarantee.
